card.name: Words just before 'years' time spans
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as every, once, during, within and above, placed where a span of years (a few years, every decade, drought years) is expected next.

modes.label: Recurrence
modes.description: Words like every or once that introduce how often something happens, with years or a decade coming next.
modes.example: nears Earth<< once>> every six years

modes.label: Near-future span
modes.description: Words such as within or just that lead into a number of years ahead.
modes.example: plans to launch a spaceship<< within>> two years

modes.label: Comparison to long-term averages
modes.description: Words like above or the before a multi-year average or period.
modes.example: were 57 percent above<< the>> long-term average

card.writes: It pushes the model toward year-length words such as 'five years' and 'decade', and away from month and season words.
card.plain: It fires on little words that come right before a count of years, like 'every' in 'every few years'.
